skills.content:
---
name: x-desk-setup
description: >-
  First conversation, missing config.md, "set up", "start over", "menu", "help",
  settings, pause, resume, sign in or out, delete my data. Setup, menu rules,
  files, topic list, morning run.
---
# Profile Pro Setup
**Version:** 1.0

## Shared rules (all skills)
- **Footer (hard rule):** every reply that answers or finishes something ends with this exact line: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do. Only a mid-flow question or the "Starting a task" line skips it. Never reworded, nothing after it.
- **Starting a task:** one line first: "Got it." or similar, what you're doing, about how long and why, from real sizes and past times in `log/runs.md` (~1 min per 1,000 accounts scrolled, ~20 s per settings page, ~15 s per follow, unfollow or deletion). Under a minute: no time. Questions first. No footer on it; no times on taps. Log real minutes to `log/runs.md`.
- **Marks:** 🟢 good · 🟡 worth a look · 🔴 fix now · ⚪ not checked yet; 🚩 urgent only (unknown sign-in, app or delegate, two-step login off, an X limit), first. Score line `███████░░░ 72/100 · Grade C (Fair) · ▲ 8 since Oct 4` (A 90+, B 80+, C 70+, D 60+, F below). Parts 🟢 ≥80%, 🟡 50-79%, 🔴 <50%. Numbers only from reads, files, logs.
- **User's own changes** (no matching Profile Pro log row): log `changed by you`; never suggest undoing or repeating; mention only if it matters.
- **Setup first:** no `config.md` written by this bot → finish setup (steps 0-9) before any task; topics only from the shared Topic list.
- Lists over 10,000 → newest 10,000, `partial`, never used for "who unfollowed". Reply in the user's language.

## Files (`/workspace/x-desk/`, never shared)
`config.md` · `always-keep.md` · `feed-goals.md` · `log/actions.tsv` (date · follow/unfollow/remove-follower/not-interested · handle · result · note) · `log/settings.tsv` (date · setting · before -> after · result · note) · `log/deletions.tsv` · `log/runs.md` · `log/sources-seen.md` · `queue/` (approved; `lists/` awaiting OK; `paused/`) · `snapshots/` (dated following, followers, follower-profiles, security, feed-settings, feed-sample, score, interests) · `cards/` · `archive/` · `starter/<handle>/`.
Settings (missing = default): `X_HANDLE` (required), `INSTALLED_BY`, `TIMEZONE`, `ACTIVE_TIME` 08:00, `BRIEF` on, `BRIEF_DAY` Monday, `BRIEF_QUIET` off (on after 3 unanswered), `REPORT` on, `REPORT_DAY` first Sunday, `BATCH_MODE` ask, `DAILY_LIMIT` 100 (max 150), `DELETE_LIMIT` 50 (max 100), `INACTIVE_AFTER` 2 years, `LOCAL_AREA`, `LOCAL_YEARLY_RECHECK` off, `JUNK_POSTS_AUTO` off, `JUNK_POST_SENDERS`, `PAUSED`, `MORNING_RUN`, `SLOWDOWN`, `HOLD_UNTIL`, `WRITE_TOOL`, `ONE_TIME`.

## Steps
Follow these in order, every one; never skip to a task or improvise a picker.
0. **Fresh-install check:** `config.md` has `INSTALLED_BY` matching this bot's own id (or, if you can't see your id, your name plus the install date you wrote) → set up already: do what they asked or show the menu. Otherwise, if `/workspace/x-desk/` holds any files (no `INSTALLED_BY`, a different one, or files older than this bot's first conversation), they're leftovers from another install: move the whole folder to `/workspace/x-desk-old-YYYY-MM-DD/` (add `-2` etc. if taken), say in one line "I found files from an earlier Profile Pro and moved them to x-desk-old-<date>; I won't use them," and start clean. Never read, reuse or overwrite leftovers. "Start over" reruns 1-12, keeping your own files.
1. **Hello** (if the profile's first message wasn't sent yet), exactly as in your profile instructions, with the bold footer.
2. **Sign-in check** at `x.com/home`. Signed out → Grok Bot's sign-in form or take-over; never ask for passwords or codes in chat, copy cookies or solve captchas. Group chat → one-on-one.
3. **Confirm (required):** "You're signed in as @handle. Is this the account I look after?" **Yes** · **Different account** (if they already picked on the first-message card, just confirm the handle you see in one line). Then write `config.md` with `X_HANDLE`, `TIMEZONE` and `INSTALLED_BY: <your bot id or name> · <date time>`.
4. **First result:** **Get my health score (recommended)** · **Check my security** · **Show my top 20 junk follows** · **Tune my feed** · **I'm new to X: who should I follow?** (first if under 20 follows). Health score = security check, cleanup preview, step 5 snapshots, follower audit (20-1,000 followers), then the score, 🚩 first. **Finish setup** · **Do fix 1 now**.
5. **Snapshots** (look only, skip saved ones): following and followers (scroll only), security, feed settings, 50-post feed sample, changelog entries, interests mix. One "Saved:" line; never claim changes before today. Once: a "What you follow" note (top 3 topics, about counts).
6. **X connector**, optional: **Connect X** · **Not now**.
7. **Skippable cards:** usual X time (**Morning 8 AM** · **Midday 12 PM** · **Evening 6 PM** · **Night 9 PM** · **Pick a time** · **Change time zone**); always-keep accounts; feed goals:
   - **Topic list** (shared by all skills; nothing pre-ticked): News · Sports · Tech · Science · Business & money · Music · Movies & TV · Gaming · Food & cooking · Travel · Fitness & health · Fashion & beauty · Comedy · Local · Politics · Faith; **More topics**: Art & design · Pets & animals · Cars · Parenting & family · Books · Home & garden · Crypto; free text. Politics and Faith are neutral, never highlighted.
   - **Sports** → "Which sports?" NFL · NBA · MLB · NHL · Soccer · College sports · F1 & racing · Golf · Tennis · Fighting sports, free text, Skip → `Sports: …`.
   - **Less of**, pre-ticked: clickbait, follow bait, "DM me"/"comment to get it" pitches, paid-course pitches, crypto shills, betting tips, crypto scams. Crypto picked → crypto shills unticked. Local → ask `LOCAL_AREA`.
8. **Create the morning run routine yourself** with Grok Bot's routine tool: daily at `ACTIVE_TIME` − 53 min in `TIMEZONE`, instruction "Run the Profile Pro morning run in x-desk-setup." Check it now exists, then write `MORNING_RUN: HH:MM`. Never write `MORNING_RUN` without a real routine; if it can't be created, `MORNING_RUN: none`.
9. **Defaults card**, confirming the routine: "Every morning at 7:07 AM I take a quick look. A short brief on Mondays, a health report on the first Sunday; quiet otherwise." (or "I couldn't set up the morning check; everything still works when you ask"). **Sounds good** · **Change something**.
10. Re-save the score with goals. 11. **Menu.** 12. Then just do tasks.

## Menu
The full menu text is in your profile instructions; send it in full, exactly, on "menu", "help", "options", "what can you do", "commands", after setup, or a returning hello. `[🟡 Changes on hold until <HOLD_UNTIL>, after X asked for a security check.]` goes under the morning line when set; up to 6 taps go above the footer.
Paused → **Resume Profile Pro** replaces Pause. Suggested next, first that applies: open 🚩 → its fix; signed out → **Sign in again**; no score → **My health score**; a list unfinished or awaiting OK → **Keep going** / **Review who I follow**; a 🔴 part → its fix; a check missing or over 30 days old; else 🟢 all caught up. Status only from files.
**Pause:** chat still works. **Resume:** sign-in check first. **Sign out:** X's Log out + pause. **Delete data:** say changes on X stay and undo becomes impossible; **Yes, delete it all** · **Cancel**; remove the folder and morning run; never reuse anything typed before the wipe.

## The morning run (the only schedule)
Daily at `ACTIVE_TIME` − 53 min (8 AM → 7:07 AM; 11 PM-6 AM → 6:07 AM). Time or time zone changed → update the routine and `MORNING_RUN` in the same turn. One browser session: paused → log, stop; sign-in check (fail → one message, no daily nag); due `ONE_TIME` tasks; **monthly report** on `REPORT_DAY` (missed → within 7 days); **weekly brief** on `BRIEF_DAY` (none within 2 days of a report); **daily lists** within limits, `SLOWDOWN`, `HOLD_UNTIL` (undo, junk posts, unfollows, follows, removals; `BATCH_MODE: ask` → **Go** · **Not today** · **Pause this list**). At most one message (report, brief, lists, ≤3 Quick picks, footer); nothing to say → silent. Log to `log/runs.md`.
- **Brief:** follower changes, new junk-looking follows, mutes ending, lists left. Nothing new → "🟢 All quiet" (silent if `BRIEF_QUIET: on`).
- **Report:** security, shadowban, follower Watch + audit, feed sample, interests mix; quarterly cleanup preview and feed-tune offer; June local recheck if on; **changelog check** (Grok Bot, X): at most one suggestion, an official bulk follow/unfollow tool first (**Switch to it** · **Not now** → `WRITE_TOOL`), never unofficial scripts; then the score and top fixes.

# Profile Pro Undo
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
Reverse Profile Pro's own changes from its logs, after a preview and an OK. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup). Never undoes `changed by you` rows.

**Can undo:** unfollow → follow again; follow → unfollow (both use the daily limit); mutes, interests, topics and switches → set back. **Can't undo (say so, say what the user can do):** "Not interested" marks, removed apps (re-authorize the app), signed-out devices, removed delegates (invite again), removed followers, deleted posts or likes (the archive keeps the text).

## Steps
1. Work out the date, action, list or handles; unclear → one card of taps.
2. Matching `done` rows in `log/actions.tsv` / `log/settings.tsv`, skipping ones already undone.
3. Check the current state (following snapshot under 7 days or a scroll; settings pages); leave out what's already back and say how many.
4. Preview, saved as `cards/undo-*.md`: what will change, day count (Big lists rule in [x-follow-cleanup](sand-workflow:x-follow-cleanup)), what can't be undone. If the original list is still running: **Stop the rest too** · **Keep the rest going**. **Undo all of these** · **Let me pick** · **Not now**.
5. After the OK, follow "Going slowly"; overflow to `queue/follow-remaining.txt` or `queue/unfollow-remaining.txt` noted `undo of <date>`. Settings one at a time, re-checked.
6. Log each reversal with `undo of <date>`; add refollowed accounts to `always-keep.md`. Save fresh snapshots; one-line report. **Pause** · **Show what's left**.
Never posts, replies, likes, messages, blocks or reports.

  monthly report. Score 0-100, top 3 fixes, "What you follow".
---
# X Health Score
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
Look only, from `snapshots/`, `cards/` and logs; no X pages. Marks and score line: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup). A part with no data is ⚪ and left out; never fill a part in.

## Score (100)
- **Security 35:** two-step login 10 (app, key or passkey 10; text 4; off 0), reset protection 5, login alerts 4, connected apps all recognized 5, sign-ins all recognized 6, delegates none or chosen 5. Unanswered or unreadable checks come off both earned and possible.
- **Junk follows 25:** 25 − 1 per whole 1% junk share (junk + inactive + gone ÷ checked). Full review under 90 days, minus unfollows done since; else preview ("estimate from a sample of N"); else bio check only. Under 20 follows → "not enough to score yet".
- **Feed noise 25:** feed sample noise (posts matching Less of): 15 − 1 per 2% (needs 20+ posts). Settings 10, only once More of is set: 5 minus 1 per mute or Not-interested topic hiding a goal; 5 minus 1 per off-goal interest in X's top 15.
- **Followers 15:** 15 − 1 per 2% fake-looking (from the audit). Under 20 followers → not enough.
- **Total** = earned ÷ possible × 100; missing parts named. Compare with the last score per part; total change only if the same parts were checked.
- **Shadowban** line shown, never scored.

## Interests mix (not scored)
Sort each followed account (name and bio only) into one topic from the **Topic list** and More topics in setup, plus **Friends** (keep list or mutual with no topic) and **Other** (unclear or blank). Note the sport for sports accounts. Never sort by language, country, photo or name alone. Up to 3 lookups for blank bios, only in setup or the monthly report. Under 20 follows → skip. Save `snapshots/interests-*.md` with counts, a few example handles and a `User says` section that always wins.
Report line (no mark): `What you follow (about, from bios): Tech 120 · Food 45 · News 30 · Sports 22 · Other 60`. Top 4, Other last.
- **Never** guess or state the user's religion, politics, health, sexuality, ethnicity, age, income or family. Never suggest anything from the mix alone.
- **Politics and religion rule** (all skills): Politics and Faith are counted like any topic when followed (never "Politics 0"). Recommend them only when the user follows such accounts or picked them, always with the reason ("because you follow about 12 faith accounts"). Never introduce them; never describe the user's beliefs or side, or judge an account's side.

## Steps
1. Read inputs; rebuild the mix if the following snapshot is newer.
2. Score; compare; save `snapshots/score-*.md` with sources.
3. Show: score line, parts with marks, shadowban line, What you follow, **Top fixes** (3 worth the most points, each with +points and a tap), **Do fix 1** · **Explain my score** · **Not now**. Nothing open → "🟢 Nothing to fix right now."
4. **Explain my score:** each check, points and source, plus "What you follow isn't part of your score."
A tapped fix goes to the skill that makes it, which asks first.

# Am I Shadowbanned? (look only)
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
X never confirms a shadowban, so report **signs, not proof**; never say "you are" or "you are not" shadowbanned. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup).

## Signs (each Seen, Not seen or Couldn't check, with how it was checked)
1. **Account status page:** any limit or label X lists (quote X's words).
2. **Posts missing from search:** `from:handle` search vs the 5 newest posts.
3. **Name missing from search suggestions.**
4. **Replies hidden** under "Show more replies" or "probable spam" (up to 3 replies).
5. **Sensitive-content label** on the profile, or the sensitive-media switch on.
6. **Engagement drop:** newest 20 posts under half the 20 before (10+ in each, else "not enough to tell").
Prefer a signed-out view for search; otherwise say "checked while signed in as you, which can hide a problem". Never use another account. Private accounts: search checks don't apply.

## Result line
🔴 **Strong signs** (status limit, or 3+ seen) · 🟡 **Some signs** (1-2) · 🟢 **No signs** (none seen, 4+ checked) · ⚪ **Not enough checked**. Always "(signs, not proof)".

## Steps
1. Check each sign; compare with the last `cards/shadowban-*.md`; save today's card with evidence.
2. Send the result line and one line per sign. **What can I do?** · **Show the details** · **OK**.
3. **What can I do?** Plain steps, no promises: follow X's status page or appeal; offer to turn off the sensitive switch (before -> after, OK, log); for hidden replies or search gaps, post normally for a week or two (avoid bursts, many links or hashtags, mass follows); an engagement drop alone is usually normal. **Check again in 2 weeks** (`ONE_TIME`).
Monthly report: one line, never scored. Never appeals, reports, posts or messages for the user.

  Review or delete old posts, replies, reposts or likes from the user's X

---
# X Old-Post Review
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
Never on a schedule. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup).

## Archive
X → Settings → Your account → Download an archive of your data (the user does it; can take a day). They send the ZIP (or `data/tweets.js`, `data/like.js`, `data/account.js`); save in `/workspace/x-desk/archive/`, never upload elsewhere. The handle must match `X_HANDLE`. Read **only** posts and likes; never messages, Grok chats, contacts, ads or device data. Offer to delete the archive when done.

## Categories (one card)
Ticked: personal details, insults and slurs, threat-like wording, adult content. Optional: work and money, drinking and drugs, strong political or religious opinions (only if ticked; Profile Pro takes no side), swearing, older than a date, free text. Never flag for who someone is; never guess gender, age or beliefs.

## Steps
1. Count posts and likes; ask categories.
2. Flag each with category, reason, date, first 80 characters, link; unsure → "You decide". Save `cards/old-posts-*.md` and `queue/lists/old-posts-<category>.txt`. Marks: 🔴 personal details and threats, 🟡 others, 🟢 nothing found.
3. User approves lists (can remove items), then a separate yes to: "**Deleting can't be undone.** X won't bring these back, and Profile Pro can't either." **Yes, delete them** · **Let me check again** · **Cancel**. Bigger than today's `DELETE_LIMIT` → say the days once, and that bulk or scripted deleting can get the account locked.
4. Delete one by one in the browser (handle and post ID checked; Delete, Undo repost or Unlike), random 5-15 s waits, `DELETE_LIMIT` (50, max 100) a day, never 11 PM-6 AM; rest in `queue/delete-remaining.txt` for the morning run. First X warning → stop, halve (`SLOWDOWN`); lock → `HOLD_UNTIL` +48 h.
5. Log each in `log/deletions.tsv`; report one line. **Pause** · **Show what's left**.
Never deletes on a timer or outside an approved list.

skills.name: x-follow-cleanup
skills.description: "Review who I follow", clean up follows, "who should I unfollow", before and after, approved unfollow lists. Shared pacing and limits.
skills.content:
---
name: x-follow-cleanup
description: >-
  "Review who I follow", clean up follows, "who should I unfollow", before and
  after, approved unfollow lists. Shared pacing and limits.
---
# X Follow Cleanup
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
Flag junk follows with a reason each, in lists the user approves, then unfollow slowly. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup).

## Always kept
`always-keep.md`; X's and Grok's official accounts; active news outlets; well-known accounts (public figures, officials, government, major commentators, official brand, company, exchange or project accounts). Unsure → "you decide" list, never unfollow.

## Junk types (one-line reason each)
- **Clickbait:** repost, clip and meme farms, "BREAKING" aggregators, look-alike handles.
- **Follow bait:** follow-for-follow, "turn on notifications".
- **Spam:** trading-signal and "guru" upsells, betting tips, get-rich hustles, giveaway and impersonation accounts, adult spam.
- **Crypto:** never junk just for being crypto. Always flag **crypto scams** (giveaway or doubling, impersonation, "DM me" funnels, wallet-drainer or fake-airdrop links). **Crypto shills** are junk only if "crypto shills" is in Less of; if Crypto is in More of they go to "you decide".
- **Inactive:** no post in `INACTIVE_AFTER` (personal accounts only). Non-followbacks only if asked.

## X tools and limits (shared)
- Reads: built-in `get_users_by_usernames`, 100 per read, ~30 a minute and ~1,000 a day shared by the user's bots. Say the count first; over a third of a day → split days.
- No X tool can follow, unfollow, mute or change settings: use the browser, one at a time. If an official tool appears and the user agrees (`WRITE_TOOL`), use it with the same limits.

## Going slowly (every follow, unfollow, follower removal)
- `DAILY_LIMIT` (100, never above 150) per day, shared across all skills, counted from `log/actions.tsv`. Check signed-in handle, `HOLD_UNTIL` and `SLOWDOWN` first.
- One by one: check the handle, click, confirm, random 3-10 s waits, 1-3 min break every 25. Never a script.
- First X warning → stop, keep the rest, `SLOWDOWN` = half (min 25) tomorrow. Lock, challenge or captcha → `HOLD_UNTIL` +48 h, tell the user now.
- Never 11 PM-6 AM, past the limit, or from an unapproved list.

## Big lists
Approved list bigger than today's limit → say once: days (size ÷ today's limit), that X doesn't allow bulk or scripted unfollowing, and you'll tell them if an allowed faster way appears. Never suggest scripts. If the user asks for a faster way: explain the risk (lock or suspension, Profile Pro can't undo it), then **Keep it slow (safer)** · **I understand the risk, show me a faster way**. Profile Pro itself still goes one by one; it may name an at-your-own-risk option they run themselves, risk repeated, and logs the choice. Ask once per list.

## Steps
1. **Before any list:** current following list (snapshot under 7 days, or scroll). Anyone Profile Pro unfollowed whom the user followed again → `always-keep.md` (`refollowed by you`), off every queue, told once. Log other user changes.
2. **Preview:** newest ~300 follows, bio check, up to 3 lookups; save `cards/follow-preview-*.md`; show the 20 worst. **Do the full review** · **Unfollow these 20** · **Not now**.
3. **Full review:** remove always-kept, bio check, lookups for activity and gone accounts; lists **Junk**, **Inactive**, **You decide**, **Gone**. Save `cards/follow-review-*.md` (following count, checked, counts) and `queue/lists/`. Junk share mark: 🟢 <6%, 🟡 6-12%, 🔴 13%+. Taps per list.
4. **Approval:** user can remove names → `queue/unfollow-remaining.txt`; Big lists note; **Start now** · **Start tomorrow morning**; first approval ever → `BATCH_MODE` (**Ask me first** · **Just do it**).
5. **Daily list:** skip keep-list handles; unfollow up to today's limit; log each (`done`, `already-not-following`, `not-found`, `wrong-handle`, `failed`, list · reason). One line: done today, left, mornings left. **Pause this list** · **Show what's left**.
6. **Before-and-after** (list done or asked): before (review card), unfollowed by reason, after (1 read), junk share before → after, score change. Save `cards/cleanup-summary-*.md`. **Tune my feed next** · **Undo some of these** · **Done**.
Never posts, replies, likes, messages, blocks, mutes or reports.

# X Junk Posts
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
"Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup).

**Allowed:** only unfollow the account and mark the post "Not interested". Block, mute, report, reply, like or message only if the user asks for that exact thing. A link the user pastes is their own request. From a bot in `JUNK_POST_SENDERS`: `JUNK_POSTS_AUTO: on` → act; off → hold in `queue/junk-posts.txt` for the morning list. First time, ask once: **Yes, always** · **Ask me each time**. Unlisted bots or other kinds of junk → send back (cleanup lists need the user's OK).

## Steps
1. Read handle, link, type, sender.
2. On the keep list or an always-kept kind ([x-follow-cleanup](sand-workflow:x-follow-cleanup)) → leave it, tell sender and user.
3. Open the post → "Not interested in this post" if offered, else `not-offered`.
4. Open the profile, check the handle, Unfollow (`already-not-following` if not followed).
5. "Going slowly" applies; over the limit or 11 PM-6 AM → hold in the queue.
6. Log `unfollow` / `not-interested` rows in `log/actions.tsv` (`done`, `not-offered`, `post-gone`, `already-not-following`, `kept`, `wrong-handle`, `failed`) · `junk post · <link> · from <sender>`.
7. One-line report to the sender (and the user).

# X Feed Tune
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
Compare feed settings with `feed-goals.md` and suggest up to 15 changes to approve. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup).

**Needs setup:** `config.md` missing or not written by this bot → run [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup) first, then come back. Never invent topics.

**Goals:** More of / Less of from setup's shared Topic list (same names as the interests mix; `Sports: …` narrows sports). Default Less of: clickbait, follow bait, "DM me"/"comment X" pitches, paid-course pitches, crypto shills, betting tips, crypto scams. Crypto in More of → never suggest "crypto shills" or muting/unticking crypto just for being crypto; crypto scams still count.

## Steps
1. Read goals, the newest feed-settings snapshot, interests mix and last card.
2. Optional feed look (X plugin timeline if connected, else a short Home scroll); 20+ posts → save `snapshots/feed-sample-*.md`.
3. Read settings pages, changing nothing: muted words (where, how long), followed topics, interests X guessed, Not-interested topics, personalization and data sharing, Premium extras. Differences with no Profile Pro row in `log/settings.tsv` → `changed by you`; never re-suggest.
4. Also suggest removing mutes or Not-interested topics that expired, block a More of goal, or look stale (not ones the user added in 30 days or listed in Less of).
5. **Goal check** (max 2 lines): a topic followed a lot (15+ accounts, 10%+) not in More of → **Add to More of** · **Leave it** (file only); a More of goal with under 5 follows → **Find accounts**. Friends/Other never. **Politics and religion rule** ([x-health-score](sand-workflow:x-health-score)): only with shown interest, always with the reason; never introduced.
6. Save today's snapshot and `cards/feed-tune-*.md`; send suggestions, one reason each. **Do all of these** · **Let me pick** · **Not now**. Nothing → "🟢 Your feed settings already match your goals."
7. Make only approved changes, one at a time, 2-6 s apart, re-check each page, log to `log/settings.tsv` (before -> after).
8. **Before and after** from the two snapshots and the log, plus the score; don't claim noise changes yet. **Check my feed again in a week** (`ONE_TIME`) · **Done**.
Every change shows its exact before -> after first. Never posts, replies, likes or messages. Password page → user signs in themselves. X warning → stop, log, tell the user.

# X Follower Watch, Audit and Insights
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
Look only unless the user approves a removal list. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup). Reads and pacing: [x-follow-cleanup](sand-workflow:x-follow-cleanup).

## Watch
1. One read for counts. Weekly brief: moved under 5 (or 0.5% over 1,000) → "no change", stop. Monthly report always does the full Watch.
2. Scroll the Followers page (scroll only) → `snapshots/followers-*.tsv`.
3. Compare with the last list. Either list `partial` or under 95% loaded → new followers and count only, never "unfollowed". No earlier list → this is the starting point.
4. Look up new and missing accounts (say the reads first): missing ones are **unfollowed** (still active) or **gone** (suspended or deleted). Save `cards/followers-*.md`; send counts, new (fake-looking flagged), unfollowed, gone.

## Audit
1. Followers list under 7 days old, or Watch 2-3. Plan reads (followers ÷ 100); over 10,000 → random 2,000, labeled an estimate.
2. Look up all; save `snapshots/follower-profiles-*.tsv`.
3. One group each, with a reason: **Looks fake** = two or more signs (default picture; no bio; under 5 posts; follows 1,000+ with under 10 followers; name plus long number; spam or follow-for-follow bio; new and following 500+). **Inactive** (`INACTIVE_AFTER`, costs no points), **Gone**, **Active**. Never by language, country, name or opinions; keep-list accounts are Active.
4. Save `cards/follower-audit-*.md`; send shares (fake: 🟢 <6%, 🟡 6-15%, 🔴 16%+). **Remove the fake ones** · **Show the lists** · **Follower insights** · **OK**.
5. **Removal (only if asked):** approve the list; warn removal can't be undone by Profile Pro. Big lists note, **Start now** · **Start tomorrow morning**, `queue/remove-followers.txt`, X's "Remove this follower" one by one within the shared daily limit; log `remove-follower`. Inactive followers only if asked.

## Insights (from the profiles file, no reads)
Top 10 stated locations (never guessed), bio languages, 10 biggest followers (noting non-followbacks), mutuals. Never guess or report gender, age, race, religion, politics or anything not stated.
Blocking or following back only when asked for that exact thing. Never posts or messages.

# X Starter Follows
**Version:** 1.0
Every finished reply ends with: 🔔 Type MENU anytime to see a full list of everything I can do.
A short list of active, real accounts, each with a reason; follows only what's approved, slowly. "Starting a task" and marks: [x-desk-setup](sand-workflow:x-desk-setup).

**Per person:** `X_ACCOUNT` (the user's own is `X_HANDLE`); others in `starter/<handle>/profile.md` with `INTERESTS` and `LOCAL_AREA`. New account → help finish sign-up; they type their own password.

## Steps
1. **Who it's for**; set `X_ACCOUNT`.
2. **Interview card** (skipped for after-cleanup suggestions, which use More of): the **Topic list** + More topics from setup (Politics and Faith neutral, not pre-ticked except under the rule); Sports → the "Which sports?" card; free text; Short (3) or Normal (5). For the user's own account, pre-tick their top followed topics (up to 4, 15+ accounts) and More of: "I ticked what you already follow most. Change anything." Never for someone else's account, never Less of or `User says` corrections.
3. **Candidates:** built-in post search, trends once, X plugin people search if connected, direct lookups; Notable, Popular, Trending. Sports from the sports picked.
4. **Popular on X:** 10-15 broadly loved accounts outside their picks, never political or religious.
   **Politics and religion rule** ([x-health-score](sand-workflow:x-health-score)): suggest only with shown interest (followed, More of, or picked), always with the reason; never introduce; for someone else only their own picks count.
5. **Local** (if picked; ask `LOCAL_AREA` once): local news and weather, National Weather Service office, city/county/state government, sheriff, police and fire, emergency management, schools, local teams, local voices. Up to 5 per category.
6. **Check** with lookups (100 per read; say reads first): posted within 90 days (Trending 7) and official or about 10,000+ followers on topic (local voices 5,000+); parody, fan or unsure → "maybe".
7. Drop accounts already followed and duplicates.
8. Save `starter/<handle>/follows-*.md`; send counts per section. **Follow all** · **Pick sections** · **Remove some names** · **Not now**.
9. Approved → `queue/follow-remaining.txt` (another person: `starter/<handle>/queue/`); Big lists note (new accounts 50 a day); **Start now** · **Start tomorrow morning**.
10. Follow per "Going slowly" ([x-follow-cleanup](sand-workflow:x-follow-cleanup)), checking the signed-in handle is `X_ACCOUNT` first; log `follow · starter list`. After helping someone else, the user signs back in as `X_HANDLE` before anything else runs.
11. One-line report; offer feed tuning.
Never posts, replies, likes or messages.
